messages:
joan: Hey team  need a small bundle for the benchmarking webinar: 1 animated hero GIF for the blog, 3 static social tiles (eng, fr, de), a speaker slide, and a lightweight one-slide benchmark appendix. Deadline: Tue deploy window. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/DEF456/webinar-bench-bundle :spiral_calendar:
design-ops: Contents noted. Do we want motion as Lottie + GIF or just GIF? Lottie would be great for the web component but need engineering sign-off for embedding.
miguel: Can do both. I'll export a 3s loop Lottie and a 600x315 GIF @72dpi. For GIF, will keep colors <256 and optimize for size. Any copy variants?
joan: Yes — produce three headline variants: 1) "Reduce per-token cost", 2) "Lower latency, lower cost", 3) "Same quality, less spend". Body line: "Live webinar: inference economics & real-world benchmarks". Keep translations short; localization will adapt.
localization: We'll provide translated headlines in FR/DE + ALT copy. Note: German tends to be longer; request wider safe margins on tiles.
design-ops: Naming convention for handoff: webinar/2026-04/hero/animated-v1.gif , webinar/2026-04/hero/animated-v1.json (lottie), webinar/2026-04/tile-en-v1.png, tile-fr-v1.png, tile-de-v1.png, slide-speaker-v1.pdf, appendix-bench-v1.pdf. Include a manifest.json in the Figma file with file names and alt text.
nana: small note on brand: avoid placing gradient overlays above the primary logo lockup. Use the condensed logotype on the hero only. Also maintain 4.5:1 contrast ratio for body text over hero background (per legal-bot earlier flag).
legal-bot: automated scan: claim "Reduce per-token cost" flagged if a percentage is used without appendix. Acceptable if headline remains qualitative and appendix link is present. Any numeric claims must reference the benchmark appendix.
joan: We'll keep headlines qualitative on social; numeric claim only in blog hero and appendix with link. For blog hero include small appendix CTA: "See methodology" linking to appendix.
design-ops: Export specs:
```
Animated hero (web): Lottie JSON + GIF 600x315, loop 3s, max 1.2MB for GIF
Social tiles: 1080x1080 PNG @2x, include safe margin 96px for German
Speaker slide: 1920x1080 PPTX and PDF, speaker name placeholder, headshot circle 160px
Appendix: A4 PDF, include methodology table as CSV attachment in the assets folder
```
miguel: I'll push drafts to the figma file under pages: /marketing/2026-apr/webinar-assets and tag @joan for review. Draft ETA: Fri noon. Final by Mon evening so ops can queue.
joan: Also route these to inbound: set UTM campaign=webinar_bench_apr, source=organic_social for tiles; for paid promos use campaign=webinar_bench_paid_apr. Sales should tag leads as source: "webinar_bench" and add metadata field: "asset_variant" with values hero|tile-en|tile-fr|tile-de.
localization: We'll need the Figma text layers unlocked for translation and a single sheet CSV export with keys.
design-ops: Will include a translations page and export-ready frames named with language suffix.
joan: Perfect. Final compliance note: include alt text with each exported image. Example alt for hero: "Graph comparing latency and cost across transformer variants, showing lower cost trend." Keep alt under 125 chars. Thanks team :pray:
